summary: TOPShipsInc filed a 6-K reporting a common share purchase agreement with B.Riley Principal Capital II. The company may sell up to $50M of its common shares over 36 months at 97% of VWAP, capped at 1M shares per purchase and 4.99% beneficial ownership. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is an at-the-market equity facility, not a special situation. The filing outlines mechanics for optional periodic sales; there is no fixed price, premium, or close date. Reg stock is the consideration. What to watch: any subsequent usage of the facility, which would dilute existing holders.
